text:
```yaml
name: PR Size Labeler

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  pr-size-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Label PR by size
        uses: cloudposse/labeler-action@v1
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          config-path: .github/labeler.yml
          dry-run: false
          fail-on-error: false
          remove-pending: true
          remove-stale: true
```
